problem_statement: Retail customers have no incentive to return after a first purchase. A loyalty programme will increase repeat purchase rates and brand engagement.

requirements.text: Customers can register for the loyalty programme using their full name and email address.
Customers earn points for each purchase that are stored against their account.
Customers can redeem points for discounts at checkout.
Marketing can send personalised promotional emails to loyalty members based on purchase history.
